listing.title: Orb Drifter
listing.tagline: Drift through a raymarched nebula and catch light orbs.
listing.description: A small arcade game drawn entirely by one fragment shader: steer a comet through a glowing nebula and collect orbs. Lowers its resolution on slow graphics.

why: Raw WebGL 2 with a raymarching fragment shader, heavy for a software GPU; scales its resolution down.
